#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <cmath>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

const double PREC = 1e-10;
const bool IS_OJ = (std::getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") != nullptr);

class Point;

class Line {
public:
    Point from;
    Point to;
    
    Line(const Point& from, const Point& to);
    Point asVector() const;
    double length() const;
};

class Point {
public:
    double x, y;
    
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    
    std::string toString() const {
        return "(" + std::to_string(x) + "," + std::to_string(y) + ")";
    }
    
    Point sub(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }
    
    Point moveAlongLine(const Line& line, double length) const;
    Point moveAlongVector(const Point& vec, double length) const;
    Point add(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x + other.x, y + other.y);
    }
    Point mul(double f) const {
        return Point(x * f, y * f);
    }
    Point normalize() const {
        double len = std::sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        return div(len);
    }
    Point div(double f) const {
        return Point(x / f, y / f);
    }
    Point getAlpha() const {
        return Point(-y, x);
    }
    
    bool equals(const Point& other) const {
        return std::abs(x - other.x) < PREC && std::abs(y - other.y) < PREC;
    }
    
    bool operator<(const Point& other) const {
        if (equals(other)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (std::abs(x - other.x) < PREC) {
            return y < other.y;
        }
        return x < other.x;
    }
};

class Line {
public:
    Point from;
    Point to;
    
    Line(const Point& from, const Point& to) : from(from), to(to) {}
    
    Point asVector() const {
        return to.sub(from);
    }
    
    double length() const {
        return std::sqrt((from.x - to.x) * (from.x - to.x) + (from.y - to.y) * (from.y - to.y));
    }
};

class Circle {
public:
    Point center;
    int r;
    
    Circle(int x, int y, int r) : center(Point(x, y)), r(r) {}
    
    static bool isIntersect(const Circle& a, const Circle& b) {
        double d = std::sqrt((a.center.x - b.center.x) * (a.center.x - b.center.x) + 
                            (a.center.y - b.center.y) * (a.center.y - b.center.y));
        return d <= a.r + b.r + PREC && d + PREC >= std::abs(a.r - b.r);
    }
    
    static bool isIntersect2(const Circle& a, const Circle& b) {
        double d = std::sqrt((a.center.x - b.center.x) * (a.center.x - b.center.x) + 
                            (a.center.y - b.center.y) * (a.center.y - b.center.y));
        return d < a.r + b.r && d > std::abs(a.r - b.r);
    }
    
    static void intersectAt(const Circle& a, const Circle& b, std::set<Point>& set) {
        if (!isIntersect(a, b)) {
            return;
        }
        
        Line line(a.center, b.center);
        double d = std::sqrt((a.center.x - b.center.x) * (a.center.x - b.center.x) + 
                            (a.center.y - b.center.y) * (a.center.y - b.center.y));
        double middleDistance = (d * d - b.r * b.r + a.r * a.r) / (2 * d);
        Point middle = a.center.moveAlongLine(line, middleDistance);
        Point alpha = line.asVector().getAlpha();
        double height = std::sqrt(a.r * a.r - middleDistance * middleDistance);
        Point first = middle.moveAlongVector(alpha, height);
        Point second = middle.moveAlongVector(alpha, -height);
        
        set.insert(first);
        if (!second.equals(first)) {
            set.insert(second);
        }
    }
};

Point Point::moveAlongLine(const Line& line, double length) const {
    return moveAlongVector(line.asVector(), length);
}

Point Point::moveAlongVector(const Point& vec, double length) const {
    return add(vec.normalize().mul(length));
}

class BlockReader {
public:
    static const int EOF = -1;
    std::istream* is;
    char dBuf[4096];
    int dPos, dSize, next;
    
    BlockReader(std::istream& is) : is(&is) {
        dPos = 0;
        dSize = 0;
        next = nextByte();
    }
    
    int nextByte() {
        while (dPos >= dSize) {
            if (dSize == -1) {
                return EOF;
            }
            dPos = 0;
            is->read(dBuf, sizeof(dBuf));
            dSize = is->gcount();
            if (dSize == 0) {
                return EOF;
            }
        }
        return dBuf[dPos++];
    }
    
    void skipBlank() {
        while (next != EOF && std::isspace(next)) {
            next = nextByte();
        }
    }
    
    int nextInteger() {
        skipBlank();
        int ret = 0;
        bool rev = false;
        if (next == '+' || next == '-') {
            rev = next == '-';
            next = nextByte();
        }
        while (next >= '0' && next <= '9') {
            ret = (ret << 3) + (ret << 1) + next - '0';
            next = nextByte();
        }
        return rev ? -ret : ret;
    }
    
    bool hasMore() {
        skipBlank();
        return next != EOF;
    }
};

void solve() {
    BlockReader input(std::cin);
    int n = input.nextInteger();
    Circle* circles = new Circle[n];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x = input.nextInteger();
        int y = input.nextInteger();
        int r = input.nextInteger();
        circles[i] = Circle(x, y, r);
    }
    
    if (n == 3 && !Circle::isIntersect(circles[0], circles[1])) {
        int sum = 4;
        if (Circle::isIntersect2(circles[0], circles[2])) {
            sum++;
        }
        if (Circle::isIntersect2(circles[1], circles[2])) {
            sum++;
        }
        std::cout << sum << std::endl;
        delete[] circles;
        return;
    }
    
    int total = 1;
    std::set<Point> set;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        set.clear();
        total++;
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            Circle::intersectAt(circles[i], circles[j], set);
        }
        if (set.size() >= 2) {
            total += set.size() - 1;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << total << std::endl;
    delete[] circles;
}

int main() {
    if (!IS_OJ) {
        // Skip file reading for online judge compatibility
    }
    
    solve();
    
    return 0;
}
